entries.defect: Diagnosis: A's four mechanisms (two-leg hull tubes, union-of-poses inflation, nearest-point weight transfer, pose-independent mask); the trouser cause stays a hypothesis tested by the in-game walking shot, as B could not see clips/rig/pose files.

Tight garments are shells copied from the drawn body's region, iso-line cut, offset along the normal, in rest pose; the region replaces its body faces; connected seat, joined sleeves and rimmed cuffs/necklines follow from the body region.

A shell vertex takes exactly the body's four bone weights and morph deltas at its source point, so construction and runtime deform identically for every sex/age/build combination; no transfer, smoothing or unposing.
Hull fill only where the region is weighted >= 0.9 to one trunk bone; up to ~1 cm ease on convex parts tapering at creases; a rim strip at every open edge.
Trousers become one connected shell (hips below the girdle, thighs, knees, shins to mid-shin); the suspected cause of report (1) is the weight transfer, verified only by the in-game walking shot.
Breast cloth and chest-wrap top: shell band with hull fill between chestTop and under the bust; removes the flange and the sternum gape; bra-like reading is a picture residual.

Shirt, robe, toga and chest-wrap trunk with upper arms as one shell (diagonal top edge for togas and the left-shoulder cape); every hem below the girdle is a driven skirt welded to the shell's bottom ring.

Neck ring, waist beads, girdle band and the covering chest beads become thin shell bands with exact weights; chest beads stay an opaque covering shell for Zulu youth and Mongo women; girdle tails hang on the columns; limb rings are excluded (U35).

Everything hanging free below the crotch is a cone of columns from the girdle ring round the hips' hull with millimetre ease and no per-pose inflation, never an envelope round both legs; no gathers; the cone inherits the ring's morph deltas so a child's skirt fits the child.
12 column bones x 2 segments parented to hips; skirt vertices weighted only to hips and two nearest columns, skinned once; skirt_weights blurring and shin/foot transfer removed.

One stateless driver per frame after clip blend, stride warp, lean and IK (order per A's reading of villagerClipPose.ts): columns cleared from bone-line thigh/shin envelopes by leg radius plus worn inner shell offsets plus ease, lower segment blended to gravity; pivots from the morphed ring; TS in game, Python mirror, round trip; same at every quality level and backend; normals from the same skinning.
Short skirt, loin flap and apron hang as panels on the driven columns from a fitted band; fix for report (2).

One explicit offset rank per form replaces the slot table, corrected: 0 neck ring/chest beads, 1 loin-flap band/girdle band/breast cloth/veil, 2 apron/trousers/skirts/waist wrap, 3 waist beads, 4 shirt/robe/toga/chest wrap, 5 hood, 6 cape/cloak; ~3 mm base + 3 mm per rank, calibratable.
Hood (rank 5) under cloak (rank 6) for outfits #83/#85/#87; one-garment-per-slot is dropped.

The mask becomes exact face sets: body and inner-shell faces inside a higher-rank shell's region are cut per face, nothing is hidden under a driven panel, the hide-bit union and the inward push are removed.

Cloaks (both shoulders, chest): rank-6 shoulder yoke shell plus back and two front panels open at the sides, upper part a ruled surface on chest/spine past the bust, lower part on the columns; arms swing in the open side, nothing hidden.
Cape-chest: rank-6 shell over shoulders and upper arms to above the elbow with a dropped hem lip.
Cape-rightShoulder: diagonal sash shell from the shoulder to the opposite hip plus a short back panel on chest/spine; removes the waist loop and the forearm through the sash.
Cape-leftShoulder uses the toga builder at knee length.
Hood: rigid head part as today; shoulder part a rank-5 shell blending head through neck into body weights, cut exactly over the robe/toga shell.
Veil: rank-1 shell over the lower face and whole neck continuing ~4 cm under the robe/shirt collar or cloak yoke; the uniform dark head at 3 m is re-checked after the rebuild as colour and material.
Baby sling stays rigid, moved to mid-back on spine1 against the cloak's back panel.
Turban, cap, headband, head ring, topknot, hair bag, hair cap and eyes stay as built; the hood rows in acceptance cover their interaction.

Residuals judged by picture: inherited skinning pinch, shell self-intersection in creases, hems entering the ground, column-corner creases, thigh-top contact in dig, lifted child flaps, tighter trousers (OPEN), bra-like breast cloth (OPEN), seam and faceting on child bands, dark marks as shading.

Remove the sweep builders, weight transfer, smoothing, skirt_weights, push_out, unskin, armholes, OUTER/SKIRTS, all of fit.py, mask.py's volume/motion/decision/push classes, garmentPush, the slot table and the asset values only they read; each step deletes the branch it makes dead, no selectable legacy path.

Keep body, mhbody, rig, clips, gltfio, export (plus column bones), gamepath (plus driver mirror), sheets/inventory applying the driver, the rigid head builders, and penetration.py as information on the driven pose.

Cost: closed-form pipeline, one merged geometry and one draw call per figure, ~24 extra bones and ~24 vector ops per figure per frame; build time, draw count and crowd frame time measured on both backends after cutover rather than assumed.
Rank offsets, column count, skirt ease and the leg-radius factor live in src/config/balance.ts marked calibratable.

No generated combination is restricted; seasonal inner garments and children's hip coverage are kept by rank and columns; the §19.15 open-outer rule stays in the generator; build error only for same-rank garments with overlapping regions.

Order: penetration gate off; shells (trousers, breast cloth, bands, veil); column rig with child hip cloths; trunk shells with driven hems; cloaks/capes/hood/sling/limb rings; final removals, balance values, docs and after pictures.

Acceptance is the picture: outfits forced into reproducible in-game scenes, side-on at 3 m and 7 m on both backends, walking/running trouser wearers, children in short skirt/loin flap/apron, robe/toga/wrap wearers in walk/sprint/kneel/dig, Tuareg rows, the 158 generator outfits' motion sheets, before/after recorded in the inventory doc.
After the rebuild, trace mesh ownership and transforms for whatever remains of the bambara [C] detached pieces and the Hausa spots before attributing them to a garment.
Remove the pipeline's penetration-over-tolerance exception and stale gate text first; reports stay diagnostics, structural failures stay errors.

Export column bones, ranks and region face sets in the glb extras; pivots derived at runtime from the morphed girdle ring so joint adjustment and garment deformation share one contract; no versioned schema since asset and consumer ship together.
Limb rings are rigid tori on the forearm and shin segments, oriented on the limb axis and sized per body, replacing A8's copied-weight band for this form.
Update the design-reference implementation record to the final wearing arrangements, including the waist-bead layer decision, inventing no garments.

REJECTED: a runtime cloth control-mesh solver with swept contacts, ground gathering, self-contact and posed initialisation is a system absent from the design; the stateless driven rig covers the inventory defects without it.
REJECTED: moot, the driver has no per-person cloth state beyond the bone matrices already held per figure.
REJECTED: control-vertex and triangle budgets belong to the rejected solver; shell density follows the body and skirt density today's skirts.
REJECTED: a separately fitted tensioned breast panel needs a control mesh; the hull-filled shell band removes the flange and its look is judged in the picture.
REJECTED: the inventory shows no missing overlap edge on wraps, only tears, holes and a sternum gape, all removed by the cone columns and shell top.
REJECTED: a per-pair directed layering graph is not needed once four ranks are corrected; every co-worn pair in the 158 outfits orders by rank with region overlap.
REJECTED: moot, the fit is removed and cuts derive from per-garment region face sets at runtime, not from pair tables.
REJECTED: a pouch, straps and identifiable infant exceed the inventory's one sling defect, which the rigid move to mid-back on spine1 removes.
